text:
alert-bot: [ALERT] region iad2: control-plane route withdrawals detected, wholesale BGP flap, majority of routed prefixes withdrawn, dataplane traffic ~0% for customer-facing endpoints. triggered by bgp-monitor. incident id=INC-2026-4782

sophie-oncall: oncall here, starting triage. marking P1 and paging net lead. creating incident bridge now.

kevin-network: acked. seeing repeated BGP session resets from two backbone ASes at 03:12 UTC. likely upstream flapping. pulling router logs.

kevin-network: log sample:```Mar 18 03:12:09 rtr-iad2-agg1 bgpd[2145]: BGP session to 198.51.100.23 went down: holdtime expired
Mar 18 03:12:10 rtr-iad2-agg2 bgpd[2145]: BGP session to 203.0.113.8 established
Mar 18 03:12:11 rtr-iad2-agg1 bgpd[2145]: BGP session to 198.51.100.23 established
Mar 18 03:12:12 rtr-iad2-agg1 bgpd[2145]: BGP session to 198.51.100.23 went down: update error - malformed UPDATE```

marta-sre: infra checks: control-plane components show API servers flapping due to route churn. kube nodes hitting NotReady, many kubelets reporting evictions when they lose control-plane connectivity. running `kubectl get nodes --all-namespaces` shows lots of NotReady.

raj-enginfra: quick capacity check — other regions have spare GPUs but some clusters near steady-state. if we fail traffic over we'll need to spin up extra dedicated instances. estimate 45-60m to provision and warm GPUs in eu-west1 or ord2; autoscale might take longer due to quotas.

luis-platform: enabling routing fallback policy now (prefer us-east-1) via smart-router. pushing route override: `PATCH /routing/policies/primary` with `prefer: us-east-1` and `stagger: 10%/min`. rolling this to edge proxies in 3 regions.

kevin-network: note: upstream is flap-heavy; even if we shift, some customers with geo-lock will still hit iad2. we should also enable node-level fallback for customer-dedicated workloads.

sophie-oncall: action items: 1) Kevin + upstream vendor on call — escalate, 2) Luis + Raj coordinate traffic shift and capacity, 3) Marta monitor Kubernetes control-plane health and node evictions, 4) Emily (product) draft status page update and notify high-severity customers.

emily-product: on it — will post a short note: "We are investigating degraded connectivity in our iad2 region; failover in progress." Need ETA to include?

raj-enginfra: ETA: initial traffic shift start in 8m, gradual 20% per 5m. full failover (100%) targeted in ~40m if capacity checks pass. provisioning extras may add 30-60m.

marta-sre: temporary mitigations: extend control-plane keepalives to reduce false-positive flaps, increase kube-apiserver timeouts to 30s, and hold evictions for 10m to avoid churn. I'm applying these now to the cluster master plane.

kevin-network: upstream vendor confirmed adverse config change in their aggregation; they are rolling a fix but no ETA yet. I've requested BGP dampening parameter increase on their side.

luis-platform: starting smart-router rollout now. patch applied to edge proxies: `/api/v1/edges/config` -> `route_pref: [us-east-1, ord2, eu-west1]`. will watch error budgets carefully.

ops-bot: Incident bridge created: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-4782, bridge: #inc-1795056789, runbook: infra/region-failover. severity=P1.

kevin-network: network status: peer1=degraded, peer2=degraded, peer3=ok. BGP flap frequency lower after vendor action, but still unstable.

marta-sre: control-plane metrics stabilizing after apiserver timeout bump. node churn reduced by 70% in the last 5m. pods still evicted for ~10% of nodes — working on rescheduling hotspots.

raj-enginfra: first 20% traffic shifted at 03:40 UTC, no capacity alarms yet. continuing 20% increments.

emily-product: status update posted to status.redwood.ai: "We are mitigating a regional networking issue in iad2; traffic is being routed away while we stabilize. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."

sophie-oncall: good. please add customers with dedicated hardware to the thread if affected so we can coordinate manual failover.

kevin-network: vendor reports they've applied a filter rollback at 03:46 UTC. seeing fewer malformed UPDATEs. still watching.

luis-platform: shifted 80% now. preparing final cutover to reach 100% once vendor confirms stability or after 20m hold.

marta-sre: still seeing a small window where kube-controller-manager reports leader elections — extending leadership lease to reduce disruptions.

kevin-network: marking upstream as partially resolved. continuing monitoring on a 1m cadence.

sophie-oncall: moving to incident handoff in 1h if stable. assign postmortem owner? raj, marta, kevin — any volunteers?

raj-enginfra: I'll own postmortem for capacity/provisioning angle.

kevin-network: I'll own network analysis and coordinate with vendor.

marta-sre: taking operational/postmortem for control-plane and remediation steps.

ops-bot: Update: incident severity -> P2 (automated) based on traffic restored >95% and control-plane stable for 30m.

emily-product: posted customer follow-up: "Primary networking instability in iad2 resolved; we routed traffic away during remediation. We will share a detailed postmortem within 72 hours."

sophie-oncall: closing notes: keep monitoring for 6h, collect logs: `/var/log/bgpd/*.log`, `/var/log/kube-apiserver/*.log`, and router core dumps. add to postmortem with timeline. good job team. :thumbsup:
